description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Blog' within the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Extension\Opencart\Module'. The class extends a base model class from the Opencart system and includes a method 'getArticles' to retrieve article data from a database, with support for sorting, ordering, pagination, and caching. The file appears to be a class implementation for managing blog articles in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: A model class for retrieving blog articles from the database, with caching and flexible query options.
